subject: Request: billing restatement and goodwill compensation for duplicate charge
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@thrivehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Possible duplicate charge on July invoice (INV-202607-001)

Hi Avery,

We're reconciling July's statements and noticed what looks like a duplicate line on invoice INV-202607-001. The net amount (EUR 7,250) appears twice: once as the subscription line and again as a connector surcharge. We only onboarded one connector for that month.

Can you confirm if this was an overcharge and advise on next steps? We need an official credit memo plus EU VAT handling documentation so we can close our month-end.

Attached: THRIVE_INV-202607-001.pdf (invoice stub)

Thanks,
Lina Park
Head of Finance
Thrive Health
lina.park@thrivehealth.com
+44 20 7946 0000
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@thrivehealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 14:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Possible duplicate charge on July invoice (INV-202607-001)

Hi Lina — thanks for flagging this and for attaching the invoice. I pulled the billing records and it does look like an erroneous duplicate line was issued during a migration we ran on 2026-07-28. Apologies — we should have caught this.

Immediate proposal:
- We will issue a credit memo for the duplicate amount (EUR 7,250) and route it as a contra-invoice against INV-202607-001.
- Because this affects VAT reporting in the EU, we'll include the corrected VAT breakdown and a statement of correction so your accounting team can reconcile (we'll mark the credit with the same VAT items).
- As a gesture of goodwill for the inconvenience and verification effort, we'd like to offer a one-time service credit of EUR 1,200 applied to your September billing. This will be separate from the VAT-balanced credit memo.

I've looped in Marissa from Finance and Sean from Billing Ops for approval and to create the credit memo. If that plan works for you, please reply and I will trigger the internal workflow and attach the credit memo draft for signature.

Attachment: proposed-credit-memo-20260831.xlsx (draft)

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, North America & EMEA
Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
From: Lina Park <lina.park@thrivehealth.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Possible duplicate charge on July invoice (INV-202607-001)

Hi Avery,

Thanks — that approach sounds good. Two quick asks: 1) please ensure the credit memo references our VAT registration (GB999999973), and 2) include a short statement confirming this was a ledger duplication from your migration so our auditors have a clear trail.

Approve the EUR 1,200 goodwill credit to be applied in September. Once you have the draft credit memo, I will circulate it to our accounts payable to process.

Best regards,
Lina
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@thrivehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 11:03:00 +0200
Subject: Action required: credit memo + goodwill credit approval for Thrive Health (DEAL-8743)

Team — looping you in to request formal processing and sign-off. Summary:
- Customer: Thrive Health (DEAL-8743)
- Issue: Duplicate line on INV-202607-001, duplicate net EUR 7,250 (same VAT).
- Customer request: Credit memo that mirrors VAT lines and a short explanatory statement for their auditors.
- Customer approved a EUR 1,200 goodwill credit to be applied to Sept billing.

Attachments: proposed-credit-memo-20260831.xlsx (draft) — contains suggested credit memo layout and ledger posting.

Can Finance please:
1) Generate official credit memo referencing VAT reg GB999999973 and include a one-sentence statement: "Credit issued due to duplicate ledger posting during 2026-07-28 billing migration."
2) Apply the courtesy credit (EUR 1,200) as a separate line on the Sept statement and mark it as non-taxable (customer approved).
3) Share the final PDF credit memo and the accounting journal entry id so I can send to the customer and close their ticket.

Marissa — can you confirm ETA? Sean — any billing ops tasks needed to reissue statements?

Thanks,
Avery
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@thrivehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 16:43:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Action required: credit memo + goodwill credit approval for Thrive Health (DEAL-8743)

Avery / team — confirmed. Finance will: 
- Issue Credit Memo CM-2026-THR-045 for EUR 7,250 (contra to INV-202607-001). The PDF will include VAT registration GB999999973 and the one-line explanation you requested.
- Post journal entry JE-2026-09-112 and mark for reconciliation to INV-202607-001.
- Apply goodwill credit line (EUR 1,200) to the Sept statement as a non-taxable adjustment; we'll tag it as "courtesy credit" in the ledger.

I'll upload the signed PDF to the shared Drive link and update HubSpot case ID 8743. Expect the credit memo PDF and ledger id by end of day tomorrow (2026-09-03).
